notes.title: August 16, 2019: NEW Graphics Engine! A whole new game!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35417582/78a487021c4f99031a173e51101c76e813b43a92.jpg[/img]
Hi guys,
we were working with an engine that didn't deliver all the graphics that we could.

[b]WE CHANGED EVERYTHING![/b]

What is different in today's update:
- all shaders.
- all textures.
- more detailed genitals.
- high definition 3D models.
- lights and fogs.
- skies.

We rebuilt all shaders, all lights, improved the details of 3D models! The new graphics are AMAZING! Very very realistic! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35417582/abd4f1c138d3707fb7e6b65bcc1433b7de37865c.jpg[/img]

Everyone that gave us a bad review about that, sorry! 

We are working really hard to solve all the issues that you mentioned. But graphics were the main problem reported for you and I think that our recent changes will impress you now!

notes.title: SIX NEW GIRLS and more!

Hi guys,

Today we are introducing a new world inside Real Girl VR with 6 more girls, 8 clothes set and 1 new location, the "Fantasy Village!

Check it out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132390/Real_Girl_VR__The_Elf_Sanctuary]DLC[/url] that contains:
+ 6 new elf girls.
+ 8 clothes set.
+ 1 location, Fantasy Village.

[b]Limited Time Offer for this DLC: we are offering a 10% discount at launch! Enjoy it![/b]

You can realize your fantasies now with 6 elf creatures! And soon we will be releasing so much more!

Thank you for all that are downloading and playing Real Girl VR, we are working really hard to fix all comments from our reviewers to bring the best sex simulator there is!

Some of the reviews are really good and are helping us to grow! 

You can also expect in this new version:
